newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Burma agrees to remove landmines from frontier.
newsitem.headline: Burma agrees to remove landmines from frontier.

text.p: Burma on Monday agreed to help Bangladesh remove landmines laid by the Burmese army along part of the frontier, security officials said.
The agreement was reached at a meeting between the area commanders of border security forces of the two countries at the frontier town of Teknaf, 48 miles (80 km) from here.
Burmese border guards laid the mines along a 15-mile (25 km) stretch of land inside Bangladesh territory in 1994 to prevent crossborder insurgencies.
The land mines killed at least eight Bangladeshis and 15 elephants.
